description: This PHP class file defines 'mantisrestInterface', a class that interfaces with the MantisBT issue tracking system via its REST API. It includes methods for connecting to MantisBT, retrieving issue details, checking issue existence, adding/removing links, and configuring the connection. The class extends 'issueTrackerInterface' and encapsulates API interactions, status color mapping, and configuration templating.

classes.name: mantisrestInterface
classes.description: A class that manages interactions with MantisBT via REST API, handling issue retrieval, status, links, and configuration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the interface, sets configuration parameters, and establishes connection to MantisBT.

methods.name: completeCfg
methods.description: Completes and normalizes configuration options such as base URL and API keys.

methods.name: getAPIClient
methods.description: Returns the current API client instance.

methods.name: checkBugIDSyntax
methods.description: Validates the syntax of a bug ID based on numeric format.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection with the MantisBT server using configured URL and API key.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Returns whether the connection to MantisBT is active.

methods.name: buildViewBugURL
methods.description: Constructs the URL to view a specific issue on the MantisBT web interface.

methods.name: getIssue
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific issue, including status, summary, reporter, handler, and version info.

methods.name: getIssueStatusCode
methods.description: Returns the status code of a given issue.

methods.name: getIssueStatusVerbose
methods.description: Returns the status label (verbose) of a given issue.

methods.name: getIssueSummaryHTMLString
methods.description: Returns the HTML string representing the issue's summary.

methods.name: checkBugIDExistence
methods.description: Checks if an issue with the given ID exists on the system.

methods.name: addLink
methods.description: Creates a link between issues or test cases.

methods.name: addExecLink
methods.description: Adds execution link details for test results.

methods.name: getCfgTemplate
methods.description: Provides a configuration template for the Mantis REST interface.

methods.name: canCreateViaAPI
methods.description: Indicates whether creating issues via API is supported.
